name: Egercsehi (Hungary)
description: Dark grey field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Egercsehi (a red and green shield with a mining tower and tools within a yellow frame) above the name EGERCSEHI in white.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Egercsehi arms in a yellow frame
